commands.label: Move or Resize
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "x"?: pt, "y"?: pt, "page"?: n, "to"?: Pos}  (x/y: the top-left on page `page` (0-based, default its page); moving an inline object by x/y floats it. to: an In Line with Text object moves to that text position and stays inline, as a drag does)

commands.label: Copy to
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"x": pt, "y": pt, "page"?: n} | {"to": Pos}  (Ctrl+drag: a copy of the selected object lands with its top-left there, or an In Line with Text one at the text position `to`, and is selected; the original and the clipboard stay as they were)

commands.label: Group
commands.parameterDescriptor: {}  (groups the selected pictures, shapes and text boxes: the selected one plus those added with select.addObject)

commands.label: Move with Text
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value": bool}  (true: Move with Text, the floating object's vertical position follows its paragraph; false: Fix Position on Page. It stays where it is)

commands.label: Rotate
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"direction": "right|left|flipVertical|flipHorizontal"}  (turns 90° or mirrors the selected picture, shape or text box; its pixels are kept)

commands.label: Rotation
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"degrees": number, "flipH"?: bool, "flipV"?: bool}  (the exact angle, clockwise, of the selected picture, shape or text box; normalised to 0–360)

commands.label: Wrap Text Sides
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"side": "bothSides|left|right|largest"}  (the sides of the selected Square, Tight or Through object text flows on; largest: the wider side, line by line)

commands.label: Expand
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"by"?: pt (default 36)}  (grows the frame right and down; at least enough to show every member)

commands.label: Fit
commands.parameterDescriptor: {}  (shrinks the selected canvas's frame to its drawing: the members move to its top-left corner)

commands.label: Canvas Member
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"index": n, "x"?: pt, "y"?: pt, "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "delete"?: bool}  (moves, resizes or removes member `index` of the selected canvas; x/y from the canvas's top-left; with no change, returns the members)

commands.label: Scale Drawing
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"factor": number (0.1–10)}  (scales the frame and every member together)

commands.label: Data Labels
commands.location: Chart Design › Chart Layouts › Add Chart Element
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"on"?: bool} (no value: switch the data labels on or off)

commands.label: Legend
commands.location: Chart Design › Chart Layouts › Add Chart Element
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"pos"?: "right|left|top|bottom|none"} (no pos: switch the legend on or off)

commands.label: Chart Title
commands.location: Chart Design › Chart Layouts › Add Chart Element
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"text"?: string|null} (no text: switch the title on or off)

commands.label: Page Borders
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"kind"?: "box|none", "width"?: pt, "color"?: "RRGGBB", "style"?: "single|double|dotted|dashed|thick|triple|dotDash|wave", "sides"?: {"top"|"left"|"bottom"|"right": {"style"?, "width"?: pt, "color"?: "RRGGBB"} | null} (exactly these sides, instead of `kind`), "applyTo"?: "section|document"}

commands.label: Choose List Item
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"control"?: tag or title, "at"?: pos, "index"?: number, "value"?: string, "text"?: string}

commands.label: Properties
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"control"?: tag or title, "title"?: string, "tag"?: string, "lockDelete"?: bool, "lockEdit"?: bool, "temporary"?: bool, "multiLine"?: bool, "placeholder"?: string, "items"?: [string | {"display", "value"}], "format"?: "M/d/yyyy", "checkedSymbol"?: char, "uncheckedSymbol"?: char}

commands.label: Add Pen
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"kind"?: "pen|pencil|highlighter", "color"?: "RRGGBB", "width"?: pt}  (adds the pen to the gallery and picks it up)

commands.label: Eraser
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: n, "x"?: pt, "y"?: pt}  (no point: use the eraser; a point: delete the ink stroke there)

commands.label: Ink to Shape
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool}  (no value: convert the lasso-selected strokes, or turn Ink to Shape on or off)

commands.label: Lasso Select
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: n, "points"?: [[x, y], …], "clear"?: bool}  (no points: use the lasso; points: select the ink inside that loop; clear: drop the selection)

commands.label: Ink Replay
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool}  (starts or stops Ink Replay; returns the strokes in the order they were drawn)

commands.label: Draw Ink
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "points": [[x, y], …] (page points, at most 5000), "tool"?: "pen|pencil|highlighter", "color"?: "RRGGBB", "width"?: pt}

commands.label: Find
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"text": string, "matchCase"?: bool, "wholeWord"?: bool, "matchPrefix"?: bool, "matchSuffix"?: bool, "ignorePunct"?: bool, "ignoreSpace"?: bool, "wildcards"?: bool, "special"?: bool (^p ^t ^# … codes, default true), "regex"?: bool}

commands.label: Go To
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: n, "pageBy"?: int (pages forward, negative back, from the caret's page), "bookmark"?: string (selects its text), "paragraph"?: n}; none opens Find and Replace on its Go To tab

commands.label: Replace All
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"text": string, "with": string (^p ^t ^& ^c …; \\1 with wildcards; with regex also $1 ${n} ${name} $0 $$ \\1 \\n (paragraph mark) \\t), …options of edit.find}

commands.label: Undo Actions
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"count": n (1 = the newest step, like edit.undo; n undoes the newest n steps at once; at most the undo depth)}

commands.label: Close
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"force"?: bool (desktop app's control channel and MCP bridge only: without it a document with unsaved changes is an error and stays open; with it the changes are discarded. Headless sessions never ask)}

commands.label: Encrypt with Password
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"password": string (Word documents are saved encrypted with it) | null or "" (saved unencrypted)}

commands.label: Export PDF
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path": string, "markup"?: bool (Print Markup: tracked changes marked up and each page scaled down beside the comments in balloons; default file.printMarkup)}

commands.label: Export Page as PNG
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path": string, "page"?: n (1-based), "scale"?: px per pt, "markup"?: bool (the page with its comments in balloons beside it; default file.printMarkup)}

commands.label: Inspect Document
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"remove"?: ["comments", "revisions", "properties", "hidden", "headers"]} → {found: {comments, revisions, properties, hiddenText, hiddenCount, hidden: [{story: "body|header|footer|footnote|endnote|comment|textBox", part?, text}] (at most 1000), truncated, unsupported: [{story, object: "table|opaque", ..}] (hidden text not inspected: table styles, verbatim objects), headers}, removed, residual: [..] (hidden text a removal couldn't reach), removedNotes: [{kind, part, text}] (notes whose hidden reference was removed)}; whole hidden paragraphs go with their marks; the removals are refused while the document tracks changes

commands.label: Personal Templates
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"dir"?: string (the user templates folder; default: the one saved in File › Options)} → {"dir", "templates": [{"label" (the file name without its extension), "title": string|null (dc:title), "path", "category" ("" at the top level, else the subfolder's name), "modified": ISO-8601|null}] (.dotx and .dotm, at most 500, by category then label), "truncated": bool}; a network folder is refused

commands.label: New from Template
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path": string} → a new, untitled document from the template, attached to it

commands.label: Open
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path": string, "data"?: base64 (the file's bytes; `path` then only names it), "password"?: string (for a password-protected Word document)}

commands.label: Options
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"pane"?: "general|display|proofing|save|language|accessibility|advanced|agents", "author"?: string, "initials"?: string, "units"?: "inches|centimeters|millimeters|points|picas|auto" (auto: the region's), "region"?: string (a locale tag like pl-PL, saved: the paper File › New starts on, the default units and the decimal separator; auto: the system's), "typingReplacesSelection"?: bool, "insertKeyOvertype"?: bool, "overtype"?: bool, "marks"?: {"tabs"?: bool, "spaces"?: bool, "paragraphs"?: bool, "hidden"?: bool}, "checkSpelling"?: bool, "markGrammar"?: bool, "ignoreUppercase"?: bool, "ignoreNumbers"?: bool, "ignoreInternet"?: bool, "dictionariesFolder"?: string (a folder of Hunspell .aff/.dic files searched first, saved; auto: the system locations only), "userTemplatesFolder"?: string (the folder File › New lists personal templates from, saved; auto: the app's own Templates folder; not a network folder), "addWords"?: [string], "removeWords"?: [string]} — with any setting it changes them and opens nothing; without, it opens File › Options (at `pane`). Returns the settings.

commands.label: Print Markup
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool (omit to toggle)} — PDFs, prints and copies show comments (balloons beside each page; a list at the end of HTML, Markdown and text) and tracked changes

commands.label: Print to PDF
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path": string, "range"?: "all" | "current" | "selection" (the pages the selection touches) | "custom", "pages"?: "1-3,5" (implies custom), "parity"?: "all" | "odd" | "even", "copies"?: 1-999, "collate"?: bool (default true), "paper"?: "none" | "Letter" | "Legal" | "A4" | … (a Layout › Size name: scale every page to this paper, centred; the document keeps its size)}

commands.label: Privacy Options
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"removePersonalInfo"?: bool (save comment and revision authors as "Author", no creator or last-modified-by), "removeDateTime"?: bool (save comments and tracked changes without dates)} — at least one; the open document keeps its real names and dates

commands.label: Protect Document
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"mode": "none|readOnly|comments|trackedChanges"} (starting enforcement; "none" doesn't stop a protected document — use review.restrict {"stop": true})

commands.label: Recover Unsaved Documents
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"restore"?: recoveryId, "discard"?: recoveryId, "refresh"?: true}; desktop only; returns {enabled,busy,documents,error}; restore loads asynchronously without a file path

commands.label: Rename Document
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"name": string (document name; its extension is kept, so the name may be given with or without it)}

commands.label: Save
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path"?: string, "password"?: string (encrypt this and later saves with it, as file.encrypt does), "markup"?: bool (Print Markup for a PDF, PNG, HTML, Markdown or text copy: comments shown; default file.printMarkup), "format"?: "wordml2003" (an .xml file as a Word 2003 XML Document) | "flatopc" (as a Word XML Document, the default; saving over a Word 2003 XML file keeps that format)}

commands.label: User Name
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"name": string (author of new tracked changes and comments)}

commands.label: Add Font…
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path"?: string, "data"?: base64, "name"?: string (file name for "data")} — a TTF, OTF, TTC, WOFF or WOFF2 file; none: pick a file

commands.label: Text Highlight Color
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"color"?: "yellow|brightGreen|turquoise|pink|blue|red|darkBlue|teal|green|violet|darkRed|darkYellow|gray50|gray25|black|none"} (explicit colour sets it; omitted toggles the last chosen colour, initially yellow)

commands.label: Text Effects
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"style"?: "solid"|"outlined"|"hollow"|"gradient"|"shadowed"|"glowing"|"reflected"|"sunset", "clear"?: bool, "fill"?: "RRGGBB"|"none" (hollow)|{"color": "RRGGBB", "transparency"?: %}|{"gradient": ["RRGGBB", …], "angle"?: deg}|null (the run's colour), "outline"?: "RRGGBB"|"none"|{"color"?: "RRGGBB"|null, "width"?: pt, "transparency"?: %}|null, "shadow"?: preset|{"color"?, "transparency"?, "blur"?, "distance"?, "angle"?}|null, "glow"?: pt|{"color"?, "size"?, "transparency"?}|null, "reflection"?: bool|"none"|{"transparency"?: %, "size"?: %, "distance"?: pt}|null}  (an omitted key is left as it is; with a shape selected or the caret in a text box, the box's whole text)

commands.label: Underline Color
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"color": "RRGGBB" | "auto"} (the underline's own colour; "auto" follows the text colour)

commands.label: AutoText
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"save"?: name, "in"?: "document", "insert"?: name, "delete"?: name} → {"parts": names, "document": the document's AutoText}

commands.label: Drawing Canvas
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"width"?: pt (default 432 = 6"), "height"?: pt (default 216 = 3"), "fill"?: "RRGGBB", "outline"?: "RRGGBB"}  (in line with text at the caret; it stays selected, so the next Pictures, Shapes or Text Box goes inside it)

commands.label: Chart
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"type"?: "column|columnStacked|bar|barStacked|line|area|pie|doughnut|scatter", "data"?: {"categories": [string], "series": [{"name": string, "values": [number|null]}]}, "title"?: string, "legend"?: "right|left|top|bottom|none", "dataLabels"?: bool, "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt} (no params: the chart type picker)

commands.label: Footer
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: number (0-based; default: the caret's section)} — the footer that page shows, created if it has none, with the caret in it

commands.label: Header
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: number (0-based; default: the caret's section)} — the header that page shows, created if it has none, with the caret in it

commands.label: Cross-reference
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"to": "heading|bookmark|figure|table|equation|label:<Name> (a caption label of your own)", "target": string (text / name / number), "show"?: "text|page|number|aboveBelow"} or {} to list targets

commands.label: Drop Cap
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"position"?: "none"|"dropped"|"margin" (default dropped), "lines"?: 1..10 (default 3; 0 = none), "distance"?: pt from the text (0..1584, default 0), "font"?: family (omit for the text's font)}

commands.label: Edit Footer
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: number (0-based: the footer that page shows, created if it has none)}

commands.label: Edit Header
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page"?: number (0-based: the header that page shows, created if it has none)}

commands.label: Icons
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"id"?: string (omit to list the library), "color"?: "RRGGBB", "size"?: pt, "query"?: string, "category"?: string}

commands.label: Link
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"url": string} | {"bookmark": name} | {"heading": block (see link.targets)} | {"top": true}, "text"?: string (Place in This Document: a bookmark, a heading or the top of the document)

commands.label: Quick Parts
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"save"?: name (from the selection), "in"?: "document" (save into the document's own building blocks, kept in its file; else this session's), "insert"?: name, "delete"?: name} → {"parts": names (this session's, then the document's Quick Parts), "document": the document's Quick Parts}

commands.label: Shapes
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"kind": "rectangle|roundedRectangle|ellipse|triangle|diamond|line|arrow|star|heart|straightConnector|elbowConnector|curvedConnector", "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "fill"?: "RRGGBB", "stroke"?: "RRGGBB", "arrow"?: "none"|"start"|"end"|"both" (lines and connectors; glue a connector's ends with shape.connect)}

commands.label: SmartArt
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"layout"?: "basicList|process|cycle|hierarchy|pyramid|radial|matrix|venn", "items"?: [string | {"text": string, "level"?: 0-7}], "colors"?: "accent1…accent6|colorful", "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt} (no items: sample items for the layout)

commands.label: WordArt
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"text"?: string, "style"?: WordArt style id (see format.textEffects), "transform"?: "textArchUp"|"textArchDown"|"textCircle"|"textWave1"|… (a DrawingML preset text warp)}

commands.label: Columns
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"count": 1-12, "space"?: pt, "separator"?: bool, "preset"?: "left|right", "widths"?: [[width pt, space after pt], …] (unequal columns; sets the count), "apply"?: "section|document|forward|selection"} (default: selection when text is selected in the main text — section breaks around it — else section)

commands.label: Document Grid
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"type"?: "none|lines|linesAndChars|snapToChars", "linesPerPage"?: n (sets the line pitch from the text height), "charsPerLine"?: n (sets the character pitch from the text width), "linePitch"?: pt, "charSpace"?: n (4096ths of a point added to the default font size: the character pitch)} — left out stays as it is; returns the grid with its lines per page and characters per line

commands.label: Hyphenation
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool (automatic; toggles when nothing is given), "zone"?: pt, "caps"?: bool (hyphenate words in capitals), "limit"?: n (consecutive hyphens, 0 = no limit)}

commands.label: Manual Hyphenation
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"from"?: Pos (default: the caret)} → the next word at a line end that could be hyphenated: {"word", "pos", "points": [char index], "suggest": char index} or {"done": true}

commands.label: Margins
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"preset"?: "normal|narrow|moderate|wide|mirrored|office2003", "top"?: pt, "bottom"?: pt, "left"?: pt, "right"?: pt, "gutter"?: pt, "mirror"?: bool}

commands.label: Format Page Numbers
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"format"?: "decimal|lowerRoman|upperRoman|lowerLetter|upperLetter", "start"?: n | null} ("start" left out: the numbering keeps its start; null: the pages number on from the section before; a number: numbering starts there)

commands.label: Page Setup
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"section"?: SectionProps} (replaces the whole section, headers and footers included; checked like Size, Margins, Columns, Line Numbers, Footnotes and Page Borders: non-finite numbers and margins that leave no room for text are refused; page sides 7.2–1584 pt, 1–12 columns with 0–300 pt gaps, header/footer/gutter 0–1584 pt, page border width 0.25–6 pt and distance 0–31 pt, note start 1–32767, line numbers start 1–32767, countBy 1–100, distance 0–1584 pt are clamped)

commands.label: Right-to-Left Section
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool} (true: the section's columns run right to left; without a value it toggles)

commands.label: Size
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"name"?: "Letter|Legal|A4|…", "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt} (each side clamped to 7.2–1584 pt, 0.1–22 in; the section keeps its orientation)

commands.label: Text Direction
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: "horizontal|down|up"} (also lrTb|tbRl|btLr; down: rotate all text 90°, lines top to bottom stacking right to left; up: 270°; default: the next after the current). In a table cell it turns the selected cells, in a text box the box; anywhere else the section(s) of the selection

commands.label: Vertical Alignment
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value": "top|center|justify|bottom"} (also both|justified; anything else is top). Justified shares each page's spare room between its paragraphs and tables

commands.label: Define New Multilevel List
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"levels": [{"format"?: "decimal|lowerLetter|upperLetter|lowerRoman|upperRoman|decimalZero|ordinal|bullet|none", "text"?: "%1.%2." (%n = level n's number; the bullet character for bullet), "start"?: n, "restartAfter"?: 0-8 (0 = never; omit = the level above), "style"?: paragraph style linked to the level | null, "align"?: "left|center|right", "alignedAt"?: pt, "indentAt"?: pt, "follow"?: "tab|space|nothing", "tabAt"?: pt | null, "font"?: string | null, "bold"?: bool, "italic"?: bool, "color"?: "RRGGBB" | null, "legal"?: bool}, …] (index = level, up to 9; fields left out keep the base list's), "num"?: list id to change in place (default: a new list), "apply"?: bool (default true: number the selected paragraphs), "name"?: string}

commands.label: List Definition
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"num"?: list id (default: the caret's list)} → {"num", "levels": [as list.define]}

commands.label: Multilevel List Library
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"preset": "headings" (1 / 1.1 / 1.1.1) | "article" (Article I. / Section 1.01 / (a)) | "outlineHeadings" (I. / A. / 1.) | "chapter" (Chapter 1, lower levels unnumbered)} — a new list whose nine levels are linked to Heading 1–9: every paragraph in those styles is numbered, selected paragraphs already in a Heading style keep it, and any other selected paragraph becomes Heading 1 (the first level)

commands.label: Edit Recipient List
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"rows"?: [{field: value}] | [[value]], "fields"?: [string]} (no params: the list as {headers, rows (every record), records (how many merge), rules, sort})

commands.label: Envelopes
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"delivery": string, "return"?: string, "size"?: "Envelope #10|#9|Monarch|DL|C4|C5|C6|B5", "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "add"?: bool (add to this document instead of a new one)}

commands.label: Filter Recipients
commands.location: Mailings › Start Mail Merge › Edit Recipient List
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"rules"?: [{"field": string, "op": "equal|notEqual|less|greater|lessOrEqual|greaterOrEqual|blank|notBlank|contains|notContains", "value"?: string, "join"?: "and|or" (with the rule before; And binds tighter)}], "sort"?: [{"field": string, "descending"?: bool}]} (replaces the filter; `sort` too when given; {} clears both). commands.label: Finish & Merge
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path"?: string (save the merged document), "records"?: "all|current" (current: the previewed record; default all, or from/to), "from"?: n, "to"?: n (record numbers, 1 = the first)}

commands.parameterDescriptor: {"record": n (1 = the first; past either end goes to the first or last record)}

commands.label: Labels
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"text"?: string, "product"?: "letter-3x10|letter-2x10|letter-2x7|letter-2x5|letter-4x20|a4-3x7|a4-2x7|a4-3x8|a4-2x4", "rows"?: n, "cols"?: n, "fromRecipients"?: bool, "single"?: {"row": n, "col": n}}

commands.label: Print Documents
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"records"?: "all|current", "from"?: n, "to"?: n} (merges into a new document, as Finish & Merge does, and opens Print for it)

commands.label: Select Recipients
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"csv"?: string, "path"?: string (.csv/.tsv/.txt, or a .xlsx/.xlsm/.xls/.ods workbook), "data"?: base64 (a file's bytes, as for path), "encoding"?: string (a text list's encoding, e.g. "gbk", "big5", "shift_jis", "utf-16le"; default: detected), "sheet"?: name | number (1 = first; a workbook with several sheets and no sheet answers {"sheets": [...], "chooseSheet": true} and loads nothing), "headers"?: bool (default true: the first non-blank row names the fields; false: fields are Column 1…N), "rows"?: [{field: value}] | [[value]], "fields"?: [string] (column order; required with array rows)}

commands.label: Sort Recipients
commands.location: Mailings › Start Mail Merge › Edit Recipient List
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"sort"?: [{"field": string, "descending"?: bool}]} | {"field": string, "descending"?: bool} (no params: the list's own order)

commands.label: Alt Text
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"text"?: string, "title"?: string, "decorative"?: bool} (the selected picture, shape, text box, group or chart)

commands.label: Alignment
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value": "left|center|right|justify|distribute (as seen on the page) | start|end (reading direction)"}

commands.label: Borders
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"kind": "bottom|top|left|right|none|all|outside|inside|horizontalLine", "width"?: pt, "color"?: "RRGGBB", "style"?: "single|double|dotted|dashed|thick|triple|dotDash|wave", "sides"?: Sides} where Sides = {"top"|"left"|"bottom"|"right"|"between": {"style"?, "width"?: pt, "color"?: "RRGGBB"} | null}: exactly these sides (others off), instead of `kind`

commands.label: Keep Lines Together

commands.label: Keep with Next
commands.location: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: Page Break Before
commands.location: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: Set Paragraph Formatting
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"props": ParaProps, "onPage"?: {"align"?: "left|center|right|justify|distribute", "left"?: pt, "right"?: pt} (alignment and indents as seen on the page: each paragraph's own direction, after `props`, says which edge is its start)}

commands.label: Paragraph Spacing
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"before"?: pt, "after"?: pt, "beforeAuto"?: bool, "afterAuto"?: bool (automatic, HTML-style spacing: 14 pt)}

commands.label: Tabs
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"tabs"?: [TabStop] (replace the direct stops), "set"?: [TabStop], "clear"?: [pt], "clearAll"?: bool, "default"?: pt} where TabStop = {"pos": pt, "align"?: "left|center|right|decimal|bar", "leader"?: "none|dot|hyphen|underscore|middleDot"}

commands.location: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: Insert Index
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"type"?: "indented|runIn", "columns"?: 1-4, "rightAlign"?: bool, "tabLeader"?: "dot|hyphen|underscore|none", "headings"?: bool (letter headings)} (replaces an existing index's settings)

commands.label: Mark Entry
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"entry"?: string (the selection), "subentry"?: string, "crossReference"?: "See …", "bookmark"?: page-range bookmark, "bold"?: bool, "italic"?: bool, "all"?: bool (Mark All: every paragraph's first match of "text" or the selection)}

commands.label: Footnote and Endnote
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"kind"?: "footnote|endnote", "pos"?: "pageBottom|beneathText" (footnotes) | "sectEnd|docEnd" (endnotes), "numFmt"?: "decimal|lowerRoman|upperRoman|lowerLetter|upperLetter|…", "numStart"?: 1-32767, "numRestart"?: "continuous|eachSect|eachPage" (each page: footnotes only), "scope"?: "document|section", "footnoteFormat"?: …, "endnoteFormat"?: …} — no settings: the options in effect at the caret

commands.label: Manage Sources
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"add"?: Source, "remove"?: tag, "import"?: path (a Word bibliography file, `b:Sources` / `Sources.xml`)} → list

commands.label: Insert Table of Figures
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"label"?: "Figure|Table|Equation" or a caption label of your own, "includeLabel"?: bool, "pageNumbers"?: bool, "rightAlign"?: bool, "tabLeader"?: "dot|hyphen|underscore|none"}

commands.label: Table of Contents
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"levels"?: 1-9, "title"?: string, "pageNumbers"?: bool, "rightAlign"?: bool, "tabLeader"?: "dot|hyphen|underscore|none", "hyperlinks"?: bool, "headingStyles"?: bool, "outlineLevels"?: bool, "tcFields"?: bool, "styleLevels"?: {style name: 1-9}} (replaces an existing table; {} updates it)

commands.label: Update Field
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"all"?: bool (the body and every header, footer, note and text box, wherever the caret is; default: the story the caret is in)}

commands.label: Combine
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path"?: string (revised document), "text"?: string (revised text), "original"?: string (original document; default: this one), "author"?: string (label changes with), "caseChanges"?: bool, "whiteSpace"?: bool, "formatting"?: bool (default true: differences count), "level"?: "word|character", "showIn"?: "original|revised|new" (revised/new: an untitled document), "moves"|"comments"|"tables"|"headersFooters"|"footnotes"|"textBoxes"|"fields"?: bool (accepted; not honoured yet except tables, always compared)}

commands.label: Compare
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path"?: string (revised document), "text"?: string (revised text), "original"?: string (original document; default: this one), "author"?: string (label changes with), "caseChanges"?: bool, "whiteSpace"?: bool, "formatting"?: bool (default true: differences count), "level"?: "word|character", "showIn"?: "original|revised|new" (revised/new: an untitled document), "moves"|"comments"|"tables"|"headersFooters"|"footnotes"|"textBoxes"|"fields"?: bool (accepted; not honoured yet except tables, always compared)}

commands.label: Delete
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"id"?: non-negative JSON integer (omit to use the caret), "all"?: bool}

commands.label: Language
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"lang"?: "en-US|en-GB|pl-PL|fr-FR|…" (BCP 47; default en-US), "noProof"?: bool, "detect"?: bool (detect language automatically, a preference), "default"?: bool (also the document's default and the saved language for future blank documents)}

commands.label: Resolve
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"id"?: non-negative JSON integer (omit to use the caret), "value"?: bool (omit to toggle)}

commands.label: Restrict Editing
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"mode"?: "none|readOnly|comments|trackedChanges|forms" (start enforcing; "none" stops), "formatting"?: bool (limit formatting to unlocked styles), "lockedStyles"?: [style id or name] (the styles that can't be applied; every other style is unlocked), "password"?: string (set when enforcing; required to stop a password-protected document), "stop"?: bool, "exception"?: "add" (the selection stays editable for everyone) | "remove" (exceptions touching the selection) | "removeAll"} → state

commands.label: Track Changes Options
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"comments"?: bool, "ink"?: bool, "insertionsDeletions"?: bool, "formatting"?: bool, "balloons"?: "revisions|inline|commentsAndFormatting", "commentDisplay"?: "margin|selected", "insertMark"?: "underline|doubleUnderline|bold|italic|strikethrough|colorOnly|none", "insertColor"?: "byAuthor" | "RRGGBB", "deleteMark"?: "strikethrough|doubleStrikethrough|hidden|caret|hash|underline|doubleUnderline|bold|italic|colorOnly|none", "deleteColor"?: "byAuthor" | "RRGGBB", "changedLines"?: "outside|left|right|none", "changedLinesColor"?: "auto" | "RRGGBB", "trackFormatting"?: bool, "moveFromMark"?: (as deleteMark; none = plain text, no colour), "moveFromColor"?: "byAuthor" | "RRGGBB", "moveToMark"?: (as insertMark; none = plain text, no colour), "moveToColor"?: "byAuthor" | "RRGGBB", "trackMoves"?: bool (the document's setting; off = a cut and paste is a deletion and an insertion, not a move)} → the options (omit all to read them)

commands.label: Add Object to Selection
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"pos"?: Pos, "index"?: n, "objects"?: [Pos | n]}  (n: its Selection Pane index; with no object selected yet, the first one becomes the selection)

commands.label: Column Selection
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"anchor": Pos, "focus": Pos} | {"from": {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt}, "to": {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt}, "story"?: StoryRef} | {"on"?: bool} (no corners: toggle column selection mode, where the arrow keys extend the block)

commands.label: Align Text
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"anchor": "t|ctr|b"}  (top, middle, bottom of the box: for turned text, from the side its lines start on)

commands.label: Break Link
commands.parameterDescriptor: {}  (the text stops at the end of the selected box; the boxes after it go back to their own text)

commands.label: Connect Shapes
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"start"?: end, "end"?: end}  end: {"path": [..], "off": n, "site"?: n} (glue to that body shape's connection site; nearest one when omitted) | {"x": pt, "y": pt, "page"?: n} (drag the end there: it glues to a shape's site within 12 pt, else stays free there) | null (unglue)

commands.label: Shape Effects
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"shadow"?: preset|{"preset"?, "color"?: "RRGGBB", "transparency"?: %, "blur"?: pt, "distance"?: pt, "angle"?: deg}|null, "glow"?: pt|{"color"?: "RRGGBB", "size"?: pt, "transparency"?: %}|null, "softEdge"?: pt|null}  (shadow presets: offsetBottomRight, offsetBottom, offsetBottomLeft, offsetRight, offsetCenter, offsetLeft, offsetTopRight, offsetTop, offsetTopLeft; an omitted key is left as it is; applies to every shape in the selection)

commands.label: Shape Fill
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"color": "RRGGBB" | null, "transparency"?: %} | {"gradient": {"stops": [{"pos": %, "color": "RRGGBB", "transparency"?: %}], "type"?: "linear|radial|rectangular|path", "angle"?: deg, "focus"?: [l, t, r, b], "tile"?: [l, t, r, b], "scaled"?: bool, "rotateWithShape"?: bool}}  (tile: percent insets of the gradient's area; scaled: a linear angle scaled with the shape; a colour alone keeps the shape's transparency; angle: linear only, 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom; focus: percent insets of where a radial, rectangular or path gradient starts; applies to every selected shape, text box and canvas background)

commands.label: Create Link
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"target": Pos | n}  (the empty text box the selected box's text continues in: its position, or its Selection Pane index)

commands.label: Shape Outline
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"color": "RRGGBB" | null, "width"?: pt}  (a selected drawing canvas: its border)

commands.label: Text Direction
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"dir": "horz|vert|vert270|wordArtVert"}  (horizontal, rotate all text 90°, 270°, stacked; the selected text box or the one the caret is in)

commands.label: Add Shape
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"after"?: item index (default: the last), "text"?: string, "below"?: bool (a sub-item instead of the next item)}

commands.label: Demote
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"index"?: item index (default: the last)} (the item and the items under it move down a level)

commands.label: Promote
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"index"?: item index (default: the last)} (the item and the items under it move up a level)

commands.label: Reset Graphic
commands.parameterDescriptor: {} (back to the default colours; the items and layout stay)

commands.label: Text Pane
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool} (no value: show or hide the Text Pane)

commands.label: Delete Style
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"style": string (name or id; custom styles only)}

commands.label: Manage Styles
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"sort"?: "recommended|alphabetical"} → [{id, name, type: "paragraph|character|linked|table", builtIn, inGallery, hidden, basedOn, priority, format}]

commands.label: Rename Style
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"style": string (name or id; custom styles only), "name": string}

commands.label: Show or Hide Style
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"style": string, "gallery"?: bool (Styles gallery, w:qFormat), "hidden"?: bool (hidden from style lists, w:semiHidden)}

commands.label: Table Column Width
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"width": pt} (every column the selection covers, the caret cell's without one; the table's preferred width is cleared so the columns get exactly this)

commands.label: Draw Table
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x0": pt, "y0": pt, "x1": pt, "y1": pt, "story"?: StoryRef} (a pen stroke in page points, 0-based page: a rectangle at least 12 pt each way outside any table inserts a one-cell table of that size at the paragraph under its start; a straight vertical or horizontal line inside a table splits the cells it crosses there. In the app the button turns the pen on.)

commands.label: Eraser
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt} (removes the border between two cells within 4 pt of the point: cells that make one rectangle merge, including cells merged down the same rows; otherwise the border is hidden along the whole edge. In the app the button turns the eraser on.)

commands.label: AutoFit Column by Double-Clicking
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a double-click on a column border: the column left of it fits its contents and the columns right of it keep their widths, moving with the border, so the table narrows or widens (up to the right margin), as in Word)

commands.label: Convert Text to Table
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"separator"?: "tab|comma|paragraph|other", "char"?: string (with other), "columns"?: n, "autofit"?: "initial|fixed|contents|window", "width"?: pt (initial column width, 0 = Auto, at most 1584)}

commands.label: Insert Row or Column by Clicking
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a click on a table's insert button: left of a row border adds a row there, above a column border a column; the new row or column is selected, as in Word)

commands.label: Table Style Options
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"headerRow"?: bool, "totalRow"?: bool, "bandedRows"?: bool, "firstColumn"?: bool, "lastColumn"?: bool, "bandedColumns"?: bool}

commands.label: Modify Table Style
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"style"?: string (default: the current table's), "name"?: string, "basedOn"?: string, "<part>"?: Part for each part name (wholeTable, headerRow|firstRow, lastRow|totalRow, firstColumn|firstCol, lastColumn|lastCol, bandedRows|band1Horz, band2Horz, bandedColumns|band1Vert, band2Vert, nwCell, neCell, swCell, seCell), "part"?: part name (the Part fields then sit at the top level), "parts"?: [Part & {"part": name}], "bandSize"?: n (rows per band), "para"?: ParaProps, "apply"?: bool} where Part = {"fill"?: "RRGGBB" | null, "font"?: string | null (null or "": inherited), "size"?: pt, "bold"?: bool, "italic"?: bool, "underline"?: bool | "single" | "double" | "thick" | "words" | "dotted" | "dash" | "wave" | "none", "color"?: "RRGGBB" | null, "align"?: "left" | "center" | "right" | "justify" | null, "vAlign"?: "top" | "center" | "bottom" | null, "cellAlign"?: "topLeft" | "topCenter" | "topRight" | "centerLeft" | "center" | "centerRight" | "bottomLeft" | "bottomCenter" | "bottomRight" | null (both alignments), "borders"?: bool | null (true: single lines on every edge, false: none, null: inherit) | Edges | [Edges], "borderColor"?: "RRGGBB", "borderWidth"?: pt} and Edges = {"edges"?: "all" | "none" | "outside" | "inside" | "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right" | "insideH" | "insideV" (default all), "style"?: "single" | "double" | "dotted" | "dashed" | "dotDash" | "thick" | "triple" | "wave" | "none", "width"?: pt, "color"?: "RRGGBB" | null}

commands.label: Move Table by Dragging
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX": pt, "toY": pt, "reach"?: pt} (a drag from the move handle past a table's top-left corner: the table floats where it's dropped, the text wrapping around it; tables in the main text only)

commands.label: New Table Style
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"name": string, "basedOn"?: string, "<part>"?: Part for each part name (wholeTable, headerRow|firstRow, lastRow|totalRow, firstColumn|firstCol, lastColumn|lastCol, bandedRows|band1Horz, band2Horz, bandedColumns|band1Vert, band2Vert, nwCell, neCell, swCell, seCell), "part"?: part name (the Part fields then sit at the top level), "parts"?: [Part & {"part": name}], "bandSize"?: n (rows per band), "para"?: ParaProps, "apply"?: bool} where Part = {"fill"?: "RRGGBB" | null, "font"?: string | null (null or "": inherited), "size"?: pt, "bold"?: bool, "italic"?: bool, "underline"?: bool | "single" | "double" | "thick" | "words" | "dotted" | "dash" | "wave" | "none", "color"?: "RRGGBB" | null, "align"?: "left" | "center" | "right" | "justify" | null, "vAlign"?: "top" | "center" | "bottom" | null, "cellAlign"?: "topLeft" | "topCenter" | "topRight" | "centerLeft" | "center" | "centerRight" | "bottomLeft" | "bottomCenter" | "bottomRight" | null (both alignments), "borders"?: bool | null (true: single lines on every edge, false: none, null: inherit) | Edges | [Edges], "borderColor"?: "RRGGBB", "borderWidth"?: pt} and Edges = {"edges"?: "all" | "none" | "outside" | "inside" | "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right" | "insideH" | "insideV" (default all), "style"?: "single" | "double" | "dotted" | "dashed" | "dotDash" | "thick" | "triple" | "wave" | "none", "width"?: pt, "color"?: "RRGGBB" | null}

commands.label: Properties
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"align"?: "left|center|right", "rtl"?: bool, "width"?: pt|null, "widthPct"?: percent, "indent"?: pt, "rowHeight"?: pt|null, "rowHeightRule"?: "atLeast|exact", "allowBreak"?: bool, "headerRow"?: bool, "columnWidth"?: pt, "cellWidth"?: pt|null, "valign"?: "top|center|bottom"} (row, column and cell settings apply to the caret's; without settings it returns the current ones)

commands.label: Resize Table by Dragging
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX": pt, "toY": pt, "shift"?: bool, "ctrl"?: bool, "reach"?: pt} (a mouse drag in page points, 0-based page, starting on a table border or the resize handle: a column border moves (the column to its right gives or takes the difference, so the table keeps its width; with ctrl the columns right of it share it in proportion; with shift, or on the table's right edge, only the column left of it changes); the table's left edge moves a left-aligned table's indent, the first column making up the difference (a centred or right-aligned table keeps its alignment: only the first column changes); with cells of the table selected, a border of theirs moves only in their rows; a row's bottom border sets that row's height; the handle just outside the bottom-right corner scales every column and the rows on that page. `reach` (default 3) is how near the start has to be.)

commands.label: Table Row Height
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"height": pt, "rule"?: "atLeast|exact"} (every row the selection covers, the caret's without one)

commands.label: Right-to-Left Table
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: bool} (true: the first column stands at the right; without a value it toggles)

commands.label: Select Table Cells by Clicking
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"page": n, "x": pt, "y": pt, "toX"?: pt, "toY"?: pt, "reach"?: pt, "extend"?: bool, "anchorRow"?: n} (a click in page points, 0-based page, on a selection area of a table in the caret's story: just above a column selects the column, left of a row the row, along a cell's left edge inside it the cell, the move handle past the top-left corner the table; with toX/toY (a drag) every column, row or cell from there to that point; the page margin beside a table (its leading side: right for a right-to-left table) is a row area too, and `extend` (Shift+click) on one takes the rows from the selected ones' anchor, or from row `anchorRow` (0-based) when given, so a drag keeps its press's anchor. `reach` (default 3) is the column borders' resize reach, which the cell areas keep clear of.)

commands.label: Split Cells
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"columns"?: n (2), "rows"?: n (1), "mergeFirst"?: bool (true: several selected cells are merged first)}

commands.label: Text Direction
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: "horizontal|down|up"} (default: the next direction after the caret cell's, like Word's button)

commands.label: Convert to Text
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"separator"?: "tab|comma|paragraph|other", "char"?: string (with other)} (the selected rows, or the whole table)

commands.label: Type Character Code
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"code": string (decimal digits as typed on the keypad, e.g. "0233"), "ansi"?: 874 | 1250–1258 (the leading-0 code page, default 1252), "oem"?: 437 | 737 | 850 | 852 | 857 | 866 (default from the locale)}

commands.label: Attach Template
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path": string, "linkStyles"?: bool, "update"?: bool (update the styles from it now), "data"?: base64 (the template's bytes, for "update")}

commands.label: AutoCorrect Options
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"enabled"?: bool (all of AutoCorrect), "replaceText"|"twoInitialCaps"|"capSentences"|"capCells"|"capDays"|"capsLock"|"smartQuotes"|"fractions"|"ordinals"|"dashes"|"links"|"bullets"|"numbering"|"borderLines"?: bool, "boldItalic"?: bool (*bold* and _italic_ with real formatting; default false), "tabIndent"?: bool (Set left- and first-indent with tabs and backspaces; default false), "headingStyles"?: bool (Built-in Heading styles; default false), "doubleSpacePeriod"?: bool (Add a period with double-space; default false), "autoAddFirstLetter"|"autoAddInitialCaps"?: bool (Automatically add words to the exception lists when an automatic capital is undone; default true), "add"?: {"from": string, "to": string} (adds or replaces an entry), "delete"?: string (an entry's "from", built in or added), "addException"?: string, "deleteException"?: string, "addInitialCapsException"?: string (keeps TWo INitial CApitals, like "IDs"), "deleteInitialCapsException"?: string} → options, entries and exceptions

commands.label: Customize Keyboard
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"command"?: id (its keys), "key"?: "Mod+Shift+K" (the command it runs), "assign"?: {"command": id, "key": string}, "remove"?: {"command": id, "key": string}, "reset"?: true (built-in keys only)} → {custom: {assigned: {key: id}, removed: [key]}, …}; no params opens the dialog

commands.label: Customize Ribbon
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"hide"?: tab, "show"?: tab, "newTab"?: {"name"?, "after"?: tab}, "newGroup"?: {"tab", "name"?}, "add"?: {"tab", "group", "command", "after"?: id}, "remove"?: {"tab", "group"?, "command"?}, "rename"?: {"tab", "group"?, "to"}, "move"?: {"tab", "group"?, "command"?, "by": int}, "qatAdd"?: id, "qatRemove"?: id, "qatMove"?: {"command", "by": int}, "reset"?: true | "ribbon" | "qat", "layout"?: object} → {tabs: [{name, custom?, hidden?, groups?: [{name, commands}]}], qat: [id]}; only custom tabs and groups can be renamed or removed (built-in tabs can be hidden and moved); no params opens the dialog

commands.label: Search
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"query"?: string} → {matches: [{id, label, location, shortcut}]} (every word of the query in the label, location or id; at most 50); no query opens the Search box

commands.label: Templates and Add-ins
commands.parameterDescriptor: {} → {"template": path|null, "linkStyles": bool} (from the ribbon, the app shows the dialog)

commands.label: Update Styles from Template
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"path"?: string (default: the attached template), "data"?: base64 (the file's bytes; `path` then only names it)} → {"added", "replaced"}

commands.label: Interface Theme
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"value"?: "light" | "dark" | "system"; without it, toggles light and dark}

commands.label: Transform
commands.parameterDescriptor: {"preset": "textArchUp"|"textArchDown"|"textCircle"|"textWave1"|"textSlantUp"|"textSlantDown"|"textInflate"|"textDeflate"|"textChevron"|"textChevronInverted"|"textTriangle"|"textTriangleInverted"|… (any DrawingML preset text warp)|"none", "adj"?: n (the preset's adjust value)}
